scripts.build: npm run copy:env && vite build && npm run copy:env:dist
scripts.build:dev: npm run copy:env:dev && vite build && npm run copy:env:dist
scripts.copy:env:dist: cp .env dist/.env 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: .env file not found, skipping copy' && cp authorized_key.json dist/authorized_key.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: authorized_key.json file not found, skipping copy'
scripts.copy:env:dev: cp .config/env/.env.development ./.env 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: .env file not found, skipping copy' && cp authorized_key.json dist/authorized_key.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: authorized_key.json file not found, skipping copy'
scripts.copy:env: cp .config/env/.env.production ./.env 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: .env file not found, skipping copy' && cp authorized_key.json dist/authorized_key.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: authorized_key.json file not found, skipping copy'
